subject: Next steps: procurement readiness & hosting preference for Acme Health
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acmehealth.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & quick procurement questions

Alex / team — thanks again for the time on today’s call. Quick recap and items needed from procurement so we can align pricing/packaging before legal: 

- Hosting preference: you mentioned wanting to pilot on hosted and then evaluate dedicated or private VPC for PHI. Can you confirm that remains the plan?
- Procurement instrument: will you require a PO for the initial contract, or is company card acceptable for the pilot? If PO, please confirm procurement lead and billing cadence.
- Marketplace: is buying through cloud marketplace (AWS Marketplace) something procurement prefers, or would a direct Redwood contract be better for your teams?
- Commit horizon: do you expect to consider a committed monthly spend after pilot (e.g., 6–12 month commit) or will you continue on on-demand?
- Compliance/Docs: you asked for SOC 2 evidence and data residency details — sending the links in my next message.

Attached: draft MA (Acme_MA_Draft_v2.pdf) and a compact SOW/pricing options spreadsheet (SOW-hosting-options.xlsx) to give procurement a simple decision matrix.

Can you get back to me with the procurement contact (name/email), preferred payment instrument (PO vs card), and an estimated timeline for procurement review? If it helps, we can schedule a 30-minute alignment with procurement + finance next week.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Aug 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & quick procurement questions

Rishi — appreciate the clear recap and the docs. Quick answers from my side: 

- Hosting: yes — we want to pilot on hosted (no VPC for pilot). After a 90-day pilot we will evaluate moving to Dedicated (reserved infra) if the latency and costs meet expectations. Private/VPC is a longer-term ask for PHI workloads but not required initially.
- Procurement instrument: for anything over $5k/month procurement will want a PO. For the pilot (range TBD) we can use a company card if the finance owner signs off, but prefer to have a PO route ready.
- Marketplace: procurement is open to marketplace purchases if pricing and billing terms are comparable. They like the simplified procurement/chargeback workflows marketplaces provide.
- Commit horizon: we are leaning toward a 12-month commit if performance and unit economics work, but we need the pilot data first.
- Timeline & contact: procurement lead is Jamie Ortiz (jamie.ortiz@acmehealth.com). Expect procurement review to take ~3–6 weeks once we deliver final SOW and pricing.

Also: please include SOC 2 Type II, data residency options for US-only, and a short note on how Redwood handles KV-cache and prefix caching (our security folks asked).

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Product Manager, AI Platforms
Acme Health
alex.chen@acmehealth.com

Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & quick procurement questions — proposed options + next steps

Thanks Alex — looping Jamie and sharing more detail so procurement has a clear decision slate. Neha (SE) and Dylan (billing) are on the thread to help with technical and finance Qs. 

High-level commercial options for procurement to consider (attached SOW/pricing spreadsheet shows line items):

Option A — Hosted (on-demand) pilot- Quickest to start, charged per usage (tokens/embedding units)- No infra commit; good for 30–90 day proof of concept- Suggested pilot budget estimate: $3k–8k for a limited test depending on volume

Option B — Dedicated (12‑month commit)- Reserved GPU capacity and throughput SLAs; predictable monthly fee and lower per-token unit cost- Start with a 3‑month ramp to target throughput, then settle on committed baseline- Ballpark: typical entry: $10k/month committed for baseline pool (custom quote to follow)

Option C — Private (VPC/on‑prem)- For PHI workloads and long-term control; includes DC/networking work and separate license/installation fees- Procurement/infra effort higher — requires legal + infra sync

Ask for procurement: please confirm which option procurement prefers (A/B/C), whether they will issue a PO for the pilot or prefer card, and any mandatory contract clauses (e.g., data residency, subcontractor disclosure).

Next steps I propose: 
1) We finalize the SOW and produce a clean quote for Option B (Dedicated commit) and Option A (pilot).
2) Schedule a 30–45 min procurement + finance call (suggest Tue or Wed afternoon next week).
3) We provide SOC 2 Type II report link and a short technical note on KV/prefix caching to security and procurement.

Links/attachments: SOW-hosting-options.xlsx (pricing matrix), Acme_MA_Draft_v2.pdf (master agreement draft), SOC2_and_security_notes.pdf (link). Also created a HubSpot quote placeholder: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/5231.

Dylan — can you draft a short quote for Option A (pilot card or PO) and Option B (12‑mo commit) we can send to Jamie? Neha — can you prepare a one‑page tech brief on caching and data residency to attach to the SOW?

Appreciate it — R

Rishi / Alex — thanks for the options. Procurement preference at this time: 

- We will proceed with a PO for any ongoing charges beyond the pilot. For the pilot (up to $8k) we can accept a card to move faster, but would like the PO flow ready.
- Preferred commercial path: Option B (12‑month committed Dedicated) if Redwood can provide a firm entry-level quote and SLA language. We want the pilot to validate performance, then execute the committed contract.
- Legal asks: please include a data residency clause restricting EU/UK/US data to the US for now, and include SOC 2 evidence. We will also need a contact for Redwood legal to send redlines; cc our legal inbox procurement@acmehealth.com.

Next action for Redwood: send a formal quote for Option B (12‑mo commit) and a pilot quote (card/PO toggles). Please include the SOW and a point of contact for legal. We should be able to turn this in 3–6 weeks once we have the final docs.

Jamie Ortiz
